items.titleEn: Blue Jays decline Straw's $8 million option amid roster moves
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have declined their $8 million club option on outfielder Myles Straw, the first necessary decision as the offseason officially begins and free agency opens.
Straw’s deal included a $1.75 million buyout, which will be covered by the cash considerations sent over from the Guardians in the deal prior to the 2025 season.

Straw’s news headlined a flurry of roster moves for the Blue Jays Monday, as they set their 40-man roster for the offseason by reinstating all players from the 60-day IL. That group includes: right-handers José Berríos, Jake Bloss, Bowden Francis and Cody Ponce; outfielders Jonatan Clase and OF Anthony Santander and right fielder Addison Barger. Additionally, right-hander CJ Van Eyk cleared waivers and was assigned to Triple-A, clearing a 40-man spot.

Of that group, Berríos and Francis, both recovering from Tommy John surgery, still have plenty of rehab in front of them and can be placed back on the 60-day IL in spring when camps officially begin. It’s also possible that Barger (right elbow surgery) could need additional time, but all others are expected to be healthy for 2027.

When the Blue Jays first acquired Straw, it felt like he represented more of a financial move than a baseball one. He was coming off a season in which he’d spent much of the year in Triple-A for the Guardians, and he was still owed $13.8 million across 2025-26. The Blue Jays' primary motivation in that deal was to add international pool money to bolster their pursuit of Japanese righty Roki Sasaki. That pursuit failed, but Toronto came away with someone important in Straw.

After entering that 2025 Spring Training, taking batting practice and fielding drills with the Triple-A groups -- not the big-league outfielders like George Springer and Dalton Varsho -- Straw forced his way onto the roster and earned a crucial role with this organization. Varsho appeared in 283 games across his two seasons, batting .251 with a .662 OPS while often impacting the game with his defense and speed on the bases.

Straw’s value was most evident in the clubhouse, where he was praised by coaches and fellow players for the value he brought as a teammate. He was often the first Blue Jays player to attach himself to a new teammate coming through the doors, too, whether that was a top prospect coming up from Triple-A or Kazuma Okamoto, with whom he became fast friends after the latter came over from Japan.

Free agency is only in its infancy, and there’s plenty of offseason ahead of us, but Toronto will certainly need to address its outfield in some manner. The emergence of Brett Bateman was one of the stories of 2026, and it surely had an impact on this decision regarding Straw, but the Blue Jays will be without Varsho and Springer, who were pieces of this roster’s core. If Barger needs more time and begins the season on the IL, too, that group thins out quickly, with Nathan Lukes, Yohendrick Piñango, Davis Schneider, Santander and Clase rounding out their 40-man options.

Seiya Suzuki is one of the top free agents available and is a clear, obvious fit for this organization, which would feel similar to the Springer addition from six years ago. This roster needs to add another offensive star -- ideally in the outfield -- but there’s still room for depth tinkering, as well.

While it didn’t come on the $8 million team option, there could still be a path back to the Blue Jays for Straw, who has strong feelings for the organization and left an excellent impression on all of the right people.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟拒绝执行Straw的800万美元球队选项并调整阵容
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟正式宣布拒绝执行外野手Myles Straw的800万美元球队选项，并同步进行了一系列40人名单调整。
bodyZh: 多伦多消息——随着休赛期正式拉开帷幕且自由球员市场开启，蓝鸟队做出了第一个必要决定：拒绝执行外野手Myles Straw价值800万美元的球队选项。
Straw的合同包含175万美元的买断费，这笔费用将由克利夫兰守护者在2025赛季之前的交易中所提供的现金补偿来支付。

Straw的消息成为了蓝鸟队周一一系列阵容调整的重头戏，他们通过将所有从60天伤病名单中恢复的球员重新激活，确定了休赛期的大联盟40人名单。这群球员包括：右投手José Berríos、Jake Bloss、Bowden Francis和Cody Ponce；外野手Jonatan Clase、Anthony Santander以及右外野手Addison Barger。此外，右投手CJ Van Eyk通过了 waivers 并被下放至小联盟三A，腾出了一个40人名单名额。
在这群球员中，正在从Tommy John手术中恢复的Berríos和Francis前方仍有大量康复工作要做，并可能在春训正式开始时重新被放回60天伤病名单。右肘手术后的Borgor也可能需要更多时间，但预计其他所有人都能在2027年保持健康。
当蓝鸟队最初通过交易得到Straw时，这笔运作给人的感觉更多是出于财务考量而非竞技层面。在此之前的一个赛季里，他在守护者队的大部分时间都在小联盟三A度过，并且在2025至2026年期间仍被欠薪1380万美元。蓝鸟队在这笔交易中的主要动机是获得国际签约金池额度，以加强对日本右投手佐佐木朗希（Roki Sasaki）的追逐。尽管那个追逐未能成功，但多伦多最终得到了Straw这样一位重要人物。
在进入2025年春训并与小联盟三A的球员们一起进行打击练习和守备训练——而不是像George Springer和Dalton Varsho这样的大联盟外野手——之后，Straw凭借实力打入了大联盟名单，并在球队中赢得了至关重要的角色。Varsho在其两个赛季中共出场283场，打击率为.251，OPS为.662，并且经常通过其防守和垒上速度对比赛产生影响。
Straw的价值在更衣室里表现得最为明显，教练和队友们对他在作为队友方面所带来的价值赞不绝口。他往往是第一个与新加入球队的队友打成一片的蓝鸟队球员，无论是从三A升上来的潜力新秀，还是在后者从日本来到球队后与其迅速结为好友的Kazuma Okamoto。

自由球员市场才刚刚起步，前方还有漫长的休赛期，但多伦多无疑需要以某种方式来补强他们的外野。Brett Bateman的崛起是2026年的故事之一，这显然对关于Straw的决定产生了影响，但蓝鸟队将失去作为阵容核心组成部分的Varsho和Springer。如果Borgor需要更多时间并在伤病名单上开始新赛季，那么外野阵容将迅速单薄，40人名单中仅剩下Nathan Lukes、Yohendrick Piñango、Davis Schneider、Santander和Clase等人。
Seiya Suzuki是市场上最顶级的自由球员之一，并且非常适合这支球队，这会让人感觉类似于六年前引进Springer的运作。这阵容需要增加另一位进攻球星——最好是在外野——但同时也有空间进行深度阵容的微调。
虽然未能执行800万美元的球队选项，但Straw对球队有着深厚的感情，并给所有关键人物留下了极佳的印象，因此他未来仍有可能找到一条重返蓝鸟队的道路。

items.titleEn: Which Blue Jays could be up for award hardware?
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- The long wait is almost over for the Blue Jays, who have been stuck waiting for the offseason to roll around for over a month now.

On this day last year, the Blue Jays won Game 5 of the World Series in Los Angeles, sending the series back to Toronto with a 3-2 lead over the Dodgers. The 365 days since then haven’t been very kind to Canada’s team.
It’s time to work on turning this back around, though, and that finally gets rolling soon:
Key November dates

First day after World Series: Players become free agents; players may be traded between clubsFive days after World Series (5 p.m. ET): Deadline for teams to make a qualifying offer to players; players can begin signing with any clubNov. 10-12: General Managers Meetings in Las VegasNov. 17 (4 p.m. ET): Deadline for players to accept a qualifying offerNov. 20: Tender deadline

Major League Baseball’s award season will also feature some Blue Jays content, especially with their five finalists for the AL Gold Glove Awards. Here’s a look at how the awards could break down and which Blue Jays will be involved.
Award watch: Gold GlovesThe Gold Glove Awards will be announced on Sunday on ESPN, with the broadcast beginning at 8:30 p.m. ET.

1B Vladimir Guerrero Jr.Yes, this one will require you to remember, just for a moment, that the Gold Glove Award is strictly a defensive award. It’s easy to lose this in the mess of a season Guerrero just went through, but his defense was excellent, and if you can look at that in a silo, you’ll see one of his best seasons as a big leaguer. Guerrero’s fielding run value of +6 was the third best among first basemen in the American League, and the eye test backed that up with both fundamental plays and some highlight-reel scoops and dives. He’ll be up against Vinnie Pasquantino of the Royals and Christian Walker of the Astros.

SS Andrés GiménezIt felt like Giménez got better as the year went on, finally settling in as the club’s shortstop after spending most of his big league career at second. Giménez already has three Gold Glove Awards (2022, ‘23, ‘24) from his time with the Guardians, and his +16 fielding run value ranks him second in the AL behind only Bobby Witt Jr. of the Royals. Along with Witt, Taylor Walls of the Rays rounds out the finalists.

RF Nathan LukesIt’s great to see Lukes get this recognition as a finalist. His defense is criminally underrated, which kept showing up in games when opponents would try to run on Lukes. He’s up against Wilyer Abreu of the Red Sox and Cam Smith of the Astros.

C Brandon ValenzuelaIf Valenzuela had started 115 games behind the plate, he might just run away with this award. He and Alejandro Kirk tied for third in the AL at +11 fielding run value, and Valenzuela did that with just 68 starts behind the plate. With his blocking, framing and incredible throwing arm, there might be a couple of these in Valenzuela’s future. He’s up against Dillon Dingler of the Tigers and Austin Wells of the Yankees.

SP José SorianoPitchers are always the most difficult race to measure, but Soriano’s reputation as a good fielder and strong athlete have been recognized here. He’ll be up against Tanner Bibee of the Guardians and Jacob deGrom of the Rangers.
Award watch: Everything else

It’s possible that Kazuma Okamoto gets some outside consideration for the AL Rookie of the Year Award after launching 33 home runs in his first MLB season, but his age (30) coming over from Japan adds an interesting wrinkle when compared to players in their early 20s who came up through the Minor Leagues.

Dylan Cease’s case for the Cy Young Award feels like the Blue Jays’ best shot to rank in the top three on a ballot, though. For much of the season, Cease and New York’s Cam Schlittler were in a dead heat, but Schlittler appears to have pulled away down the stretch while Cease’s case faded and he eventually landed on the IL. Regardless, Cease’s season is worth celebrating.

In the first year of his seven-year, $210 million deal, Cease put up a 2.40 ERA with 239 strikeouts over 169 innings, which included some absolutely dominant stretches through the middle of the summer. He’s been everything the Blue Jays could have hoped for and more.
items.titleZh: 哪些蓝鸟球员有望获得奖项荣誉？
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了多伦多蓝鸟球员在金手套奖及其他大联盟奖项中的入围及竞争情况。
bodyZh: 本文摘选自 Keegan Matheson 的蓝鸟动态简报。若要阅读完整简报，请点击此处。并订阅以定期在收件箱中接收。
多伦多报道——对多伦多蓝鸟而言，漫长的等待即将结束，他们等待休赛期到来已经有一个多月了。
去年的今天，蓝鸟在洛杉矶赢下了世界大赛第五场比赛，将系列赛带回多伦多，并以 3-2 领先洛杉矶道奇。自那以后过去的 365 天对这支加拿大球队来说并不算太友好。
不过，是时候努力扭转局面了，这一切终于很快就要拉开帷幕：
十一月关键日期
世界大赛结束次日：球员成为自由球员；球团之间可以进行球员交易世界大赛结束五天后（美东时间下午 5 点）：球队向球员提出 qualifying offer 的截止日期；球员可以开始与任何球团签约11月10日至12日：拉斯维加斯总经理会议11月17日（美东时间下午 4 点）：球员接受 qualifying offer 的截止日期11月20日：最后签约决定截止日期
美国职业棒球大联盟的颁奖季也将出现一些蓝鸟的身影，尤其是他们有五名球员入围了美联金手套奖的最终候选名单。以下是各项奖项的潜在归属以及哪些蓝鸟球员将参与其中。
奖项观察：金手套奖金手套奖将于周日在 ESPN 公布，转播将于美东时间晚上 8:30 开始。

一垒手 Vladimir Guerrero Jr.是的，这个奖项需要你暂时回想一下，金手套奖纯粹是一个防守奖项。在 Guerrero 刚刚经历的这个混乱赛季中，这一点很容易被忽视，但他的防守非常出色，如果你能独立看待这一点，你就会看到他作为大联盟球员最好的赛季之一。Guerrero 的防守跑动价值（fielding run value）达到 +6，在美联一垒手中排名第三，眼光测试也通过基本守备以及一些精彩的接球和扑救证明了这一点。他的竞争对手包括堪萨斯城皇家的 Vinnie Pasquantino 和休斯敦太空人的 Christian Walker。

游击手 Andrés Giménez感觉 Giménez 随着赛季的进行表现越来越好，在职业生涯大部分时间镇守二垒后，最终适应了球队游击手的位置。Giménez 在效力克利夫兰守护者期间已经获得过三座金手套奖（2022、2023、2024 年），他 +16 的防守跑动价值在美联排名第二，仅次于堪萨斯城皇家的 Bobby Witt Jr.。除了 Witt，坦帕湾光芒的 Taylor Walls 也入围了最终候选名单。
右外野手 Nathan Lukes很高兴看到 Lukes 作为候选人获得这种认可。他的防守被严重低估了，当对手试图在 Lukes 面前推进时，这一点在比赛中不断显现出来。他的竞争对手包括波士顿红袜的 Wilyer Abreu 和休斯敦太空人的 Cam Smith。

捕手 Brandon Valenzuela如果 Valenzuela 在本垒板后方先发了 115 场比赛，他可能就会轻松拿下这个奖项。他和 Alejandro Kirk 以 +11 的防守跑动价值并列美联第三，而 Valenzuela 仅仅通过在本垒板后方先发 68 场就做到了这一点。凭借他的阻截、导球能力以及惊人的传球臂力，Valenzuela 的未来或许还能斩获好几座这样的奖项。他的竞争对手包括底特律老虎的 Dillon Dingler 和纽约洋基的 Austin Wells。
先发投手 José Soriano投手总是最难评估的竞争群体，但 Soriano 作为一名优秀防守球员和运动能力出色的声誉在此得到了认可。他的竞争对手包括克利夫兰守护者的 Tanner Bibee 和得克萨斯游骑兵的 Jacob deGrom。
奖项观察：其他奖项
Kazuma Okamoto 在他的首个 MLB 赛季轰出 33 支本垒打后，可能会在美联年度最佳新秀奖中获得一些外部考虑，但他在 30 岁时从日本来到大联盟，与那些从小联盟一路打上来的 20 岁出头的球员相比，他的年龄带来了一个有趣的变数。
不过，Dylan Cease 竞逐赛扬奖的呼声感觉是蓝鸟最有希望在选票中排名前三的选择。在赛季的大部分时间里，Cease 与纽约的 Cam Schlittler 处于不分高下的胶着状态，但 Schlittler 似乎在冲刺阶段拉开了差距，而 Cease 的呼声则逐渐黯淡，最终进入了伤病名单。无论如何，Cease 这个赛季值得庆祝。
在他七年 2.1 亿美元合同的第一年，Cease 交出了 2.40 的自责分率，在 169 局投球中送出 239 次三振，其中包括在盛夏中期绝对统治的一段时期。他的表现达到了蓝鸟所能期望的一切，甚至更多。

items.titleEn: What can the Blue Jays learn from the Brewers and Rays this World Series?
bodyEn: TORONTO -- One year ago, the rest of baseball was looking up at the Blue Jays, wondering how they could steal their magic and make it their own.

It’s a copycat league, but aren’t they all copycat leagues? When something works, rivals rush to repeat it, and since the Dodgers seemed to exist in another realm entirely, the Blue Jays felt so much more achievable.

That’s a dangerous game, though. The Blue Jays didn’t land within a thousand miles of their own 2025 identity, and now they’re back on the ground with everyone else, looking up at the Rays and Brewers. There are some similarities between the ‘26 World Series teams and what Toronto nearly pulled off a year ago, and if the club is going to climb that mountain again, it’ll need to learn from it.
This is what the Blue Jays can take from the Rays and Brewers, which highlights just how wide a gap they’ll need to close between now and the 2027 season:
1. An ability to win in different waysThe 2025 Blue Jays nailed this. In ‘26, it felt like their best shot at winning was to hit 17 singles in a row. That’s not happening.

This is where a comparison to the Brewers is especially useful. The Blue Jays ranked dead last in MLB this season with just 152 home runs hit, but the Brewers were second to last with just 154. Milwaukee did more with its contact on balls in play, but that can have some luck baked into it year to year. How, then, could these two homer-avoidant teams walk such different paths?
Look at the walks.

The Brewers ranked second in the Majors with 668, the Blue Jays second to last at 459. That’s a difference of whopping 209 free baserunners over the course of a season. That leads to extended innings, higher pitch counts and more opportunities for the opposing pitcher to make a mistake. Over the course of a season, that adds up to a few wins. That’s all the Blue Jays needed in a depleted AL Wild Card race, too … a few wins!

That’s what got the Brewers to 103 wins. What’s gotten them to the World Series, though, including an incredible sweep of the two-time defending champion Dodgers, has been their ability to turn the power on when they need it. The postseason is full of dominant pitching, making it harder to string hits together. The Brewers have responded by launching 11 home runs in their first 10 postseason games, showing a rare ability to flip the switch and change their identity as an offense. The Blue Jays’ offense, at least in 2026, was extremely one-dimensional.
2. Danger on the basesToronto sounds like an organization now obsessed with improving its baserunning, a theme that should stretch throughout the offseason and impact its decisions.

You won’t be surprised, then, to see how well the Brewers and Rays run the bases. They’re each in the top five when it comes to stolen bases, with the Brewers (162) and Rays (164) both more than doubling the Blue Jays (75). Again, just like the walk totals, those add up a few better innings, a few extra runs and a few extra wins. This is all incremental, but it adds up over 162 games.

More advanced baserunning metrics show the same. By using Statcast’s baserunning runs, a metric designed to express the overall value of a baserunner, the Brewers (+9) and Rays (+4) both ranked in the top 10 while the Blue Jays (-3) tied for 19th and lacked true, game-changing runners.
3. Pitching developmentOne Trey Yesavage is great. Two or three of him? That’s when it starts to get fun.

The Blue Jays have taken some very encouraging strides on that front in recent years and you’re about to see those waves coming each year, but the Rays and Brewers set a high bar. This isn’t just about the headliners like Jacob Misiorowski, but also about the development that takes place in the big leagues. The Rays nail this part of the game with pitchers like Drew Rasmussen, who’s long been great for Tampa Bay since he was acquired, and Freddy Peralta, who rediscovered himself late this year after a Deadline deal from the Mets.

The Blue Jays need their next big pitching development story. Their top pick in 2026 and No. 4 prospect, Cole Carlon, is a fine place to start, along with Johnny King (No. 3) and Dasan Hill (No. 7), all three of them lefties. If Toronto can develop another front-end starter, that not only gives the team immediate wins, it frees up necessary payroll to improve this offense long term.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟能从本届世界大赛的密尔沃基酿酒人和坦帕湾光芒身上学到什么？
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟可以从密尔沃基酿酒人和坦帕湾光芒身上汲取经验，包括提升选球与垒间威胁以及强化投手养成。
bodyZh: 多伦多 —— 一年前，其余的棒球界还在仰望多伦多蓝鸟，想知道他们是如何偷走魔法并将其化为己有的。
这是一个相互效仿的联盟，但哪个联盟又不是呢？当某种方法奏效时，竞争对手便会争相效仿，既然洛杉矶道奇似乎完全存在于另一个维度，那么多伦多蓝鸟则显得要现实得多。
然而，这是一场危险的游戏。多伦多蓝鸟距离他们在2025年的自我定位差了十万八千里，现在他们回到了地面上，和所有人一样仰望坦帕湾光芒和密尔沃基酿酒人。26年的世界大赛球队与多伦多在一年前几乎打出的水平之间存在一些相似之处，如果该俱乐部想要再次攀登那座高峰，它就需要从中吸取教训。
这就是多伦多蓝鸟可以从坦帕湾光芒和密尔沃基酿酒人身上汲取的东西，它突显了他们从现在到2027赛季之间需要缩小的差距有多大：
1. 以不同方式取胜的能力2025年的多伦多蓝鸟完美做到了这一点。但在26年，感觉他们赢球的最佳方式是连续打出17支一垒安打。这是不可能发生的。
这就是与密尔沃基酿酒人进行对比特别有用的地方。多伦多蓝鸟本赛季仅轰出152支本垒打，在MLB排名垫底，但密尔沃基酿酒人以154支本垒打排名倒数第二。密尔沃基酿酒人利用场内击球做出了更多贡献，但这其中每年都会带有一些运气成分。那么，这两支极力避免本垒打的球队怎么会走上如此不同的道路呢？
看看保送次数。
密尔沃基酿酒人在大联盟中以668次保送排名第二，多伦多蓝鸟以459次排名倒数第二。在一个赛季的进程中，这意味着多达209次免费上垒跑者的巨大差距。这会导致局数延长、投球数增多，并为对方投手制造更多犯错的机会。在一个赛季的进程中，这会累积成几场胜利。这也是多伦多蓝鸟在一个本已消耗殆缺的美联外卡争夺战中所需要的一切……几场胜利！

这就是密尔沃基酿酒人取得103场胜利的原因。然而，让他们一路杀入世界大赛的——包括令人难以置信地横扫了卫冕两届冠军洛杉矶道奇——是他们在需要时开启长打能力的力量。季后赛充满了统治力的投手，这使得将安打串联起来变得更加困难。密尔沃基酿酒人在他们的前10场季后赛中轰出了11支本垒打，展现出了一种罕见的能力，能够瞬间切换开关并改变他们作为进攻端的身份。多伦多蓝鸟的进攻端，至少在2026年，是极其单一的。
2. 垒间的威胁多伦多现在听起来像是一个痴迷于提升跑垒能力的组织，这个主题应该贯穿整个休赛期并影响其决策。
那么，看到密尔沃基酿酒人和坦帕湾光芒的跑垒如此出色，你也就不会感到惊讶了。他们在盗垒方面均跻身前五，密尔沃基酿酒人（162次）和坦帕湾光芒（164次）的盗垒次数都超过了多伦多蓝鸟（75次）的两倍。再次强调，就像保送总数一样，这些累积起来就是更好的几个局数、多得的几分以及多赢下的几场比赛。这一切都是渐进的，但在162场比赛中它们会累积起来。
更先进的跑垒数据也显示了这一点。通过使用Statcast的跑垒跑分（一项旨在表达跑者总体价值的指标），密尔沃基酿酒人（+9）和坦帕湾光芒（+4）均排名前十，而多伦多蓝鸟（-3）并列排在第19位，缺乏真正能够改变比赛走势的跑者。
3. 投手养成有一个Trey Yesavage很棒。有两个或三个他呢？那事情才开始变得有趣。

多伦多蓝鸟近年来在该领域取得了非常令人鼓舞的进展，你将看到这些浪潮每年涌现，但坦帕湾光芒和密尔沃基酿酒人设定了很高的标准。这不仅关乎像Jacob Misiorowski这样的头条人物，还关乎在大联盟中进行的球员发展。坦帕湾光芒在比赛的这一环节上做得很出色，比如Drew Rasmussen这样的投手，自从被交易到坦帕湾以来一直表现出色，还有Freddy Peralta，他在今年交易截止日从纽约大都会转会后，在赛季末找回了自我。
多伦多蓝鸟需要他们的下一个重大投手养成故事。他们在2026年的首轮选秀权、排名第4的潜力新秀Cole Carlon是一个很好的起点，还有Johnny King（第3名）和Dasan Hill（第7名），这三名球员都是左投手。如果多伦多能够培养出另一名先发轮值前端的投手，这不仅会为球队带来即时的胜利，还会释放出必要的薪资空间，以长期改善进攻端。

items.titleEn: Tolle, Rojas, Clement to serve as World Series correspondents
bodyEn: Major League Baseball on Thursday announced that Boston Red Sox breakout star pitcher Payton Tolle, two-time World Series Champion Miguel Rojas and MLB All-Star Ernie Clement of the Toronto Blue Jays will serve as World Series Correspondents during the 2026 World Series presented by Capital One, featuring the Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays.

Tolle will be the correspondent for Media Day and Game One in Milwaukee. He will appear on MLB Network, produce content across @MLB social media channels and offer a player’s perspective on the matchup between the Brewers and Rays. During Players’ Weekend, Tolle drew attention for the “You’re So Pretty” inscription on his glove, a tribute to his late mother. This season he also set career highs in wins (9), ERA (3.03), innings pitched (148.2) and strikeouts (171), marketing the most strikeouts by a Red Sox pitcher aged 23 or younger since Roger Clemens in 1986.

Rojas will also attend Media Day and Game One working closely with MLB Español to provide Spanish-language coverage. The Venezuelan infielder will interview some of the top coaches and players from both Clubs. In 2026, Rojas wrapped up his 13-year Major League career with a .267 batting average and 4 home runs. He also became one of only two players in history to claim a prestigious team spirit award three times for his leadership, sportsmanship and dedication to his teammates.

Clement will serve as a correspondent for Games Three and Four when the series shifts to Tropicana Field in Tampa Bay, providing player-first coverage and creating content across @MLB’s social media channels. Riding the momentum of a historic 2025 postseason record (30 hits), Clement started 2026 hitting nearly .300 through July and earned his first career MLB All-Star selection as the starting American League second baseman for the 2026 All-Star Game.

Established in 2021, the World Series Correspondent Program provides players with the opportunity to be featured across MLB’s digital media platforms, showcase their personalities and give fans a behind-the-scenes look at the World Series through exclusive interviews with players, coaches and celebrities.

Past correspondents include Lawrence Butler, Junior Caminero and Vinnie Pasquantino (2025); Ozzie Albies, Luis Arráez and Brent Rooker (2024); Mookie Betts and Willy Adames (2023); Triston McKenzie (2022); and Brett Phillips (2021).
items.titleZh: Tolle、Rojas与Clement将担任世界大赛特约记者
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟的Ernie Clement将与Payton Tolle和Miguel Rojas一同担任2026年世界大赛特约记者。
bodyZh: 美国职业棒球大联盟于周四宣布，波士顿红袜爆发力十足的先发投手Payton Tolle、两届世界大赛冠军Miguel Rojas以及多伦多蓝鸟的MLB全明星Ernie Clement将在由第一资本（Capital One）呈现的2026年世界大赛期间担任世界大赛特约记者，对阵双方为密尔沃基酿酒人和坦帕湾光芒。

Tolle将担任媒体日以及在密尔沃基进行的G1特约记者。他将在MLB Network亮相，在@MLB的社交媒体渠道制作内容，并从球员的视角解读酿酒人与光芒的对决。在球员周末期间，Tolle手套上印有的“You’re So Pretty”字样曾引发关注，这是为了致敬他已故的母亲。本赛季他还创下了生涯单季胜场数（9）、自责分率（3.03）、投球局数（148.2）以及三振数（171）的生涯新高，这也是自1986年Roger Clemens以来，红袜23岁或以下投手单季最多三振纪录。
Rojas也将出席媒体日和G1，并与MLB Español紧密合作，提供西班牙语报道。这位委内瑞拉内野手将采访两支球队的一些顶级教练和球员。在2026年，Rojas结束了他为期13年的大联盟生涯，打击率为.267，敲出4支本垒打。他还成为历史上仅有的两名因领导力、体育精神和对队友的奉献精神而三次荣获声誉卓著的球队精神奖的球员之一。
当系列赛移师坦帕湾的Tropicana Field时，Clement将担任G3和G4的特约记者，提供以球员为第一视角的报道，并在@MLB的社交媒体渠道上创作内容。借着2025年创纪录的季后赛表现（30支安打）的势头，Clement在2026赛季截至7月的打击率接近.300，并作为2026年全明星赛美国联盟先发二垒手，首次入选MLB全明星赛。
世界大赛特约记者项目于2021年创立，为球员提供了在MLB数字媒体平台上亮相、展现个性并通过对球员、教练和名人的独家采访让球迷一窥世界大赛幕后的机会。
过去的特约记者包括Lawrence Butler、Junior Caminero和Vinnie Pasquantino（2025年）；Ozzie Albies、Luis Arráez和Brent Rooker（2024年）；Mookie Betts和Willy Adames（2023年）；Triston McKenzie（2022年）；以及Brett Phillips（2021年）。

items.titleEn: The return of these injured players could shape Toronto's offseason plans
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- For most of 2026, it felt like the Blue Jays could have fielded a roster from their IL alone, a full rotation included.

Some injuries, you can see coming. When the 42-year-old Max Scherzer runs into a few IL stints, no one should be surprised. When José Berríos has Tommy John surgery after not missing a start for nearly a decade, it’s terribly unfortunate, but we all understand the realities of baseball and the limitations of the human elbow.

The Blue Jays are trying to find that line now between bad luck and controllable variables. Cody Ponce injuring his ACL while fielding a ground ball is just plain awful luck, but when shoulder and elbow issues begin to pile up with pitchers, that deserves a longer look.
“We’re not shrugging our shoulders at that by any means,” GM Ross Atkins said. “We do feel good about the process, but we do need to be better and diversify our demographics.”

The Blue Jays have typically done well with veteran pitchers entering their early- to mid-30s. They have a “type," too. They're always attracted to pitchers with an “athletic” delivery, which means a pitcher who uses their entire body with fluid, natural movement. Think of Dylan Cease as he coasts down the mound, his lower body doing all of the heavy lifting.

Injuries piled up so quickly that it became difficult to keep track of them, but we need to factor in all of these potential returns when we look at this club’s offseason. The Blue Jays should be getting a wave of healthy veterans back, and that will shape how they approach this winter:
1. RHP Cody Ponce (right knee ACL sprain)

Ponce was just 2 1/3 innings into his Blue Jays debut when he hurt his knee fielding an awkward ground ball near first base. He’ll be fully healthy, though, so it’s just a matter of how many innings he can throw in 2027 after missing all of ‘26.

Remember, only two pitchers threw over 100 innings for this team in 2026 -- Cease and Kevin Gausman. The Blue Jays don’t need 32 starts from Ponce, but 120-plus innings would be welcome. If the season started tomorrow, he'd be in the rotation with Cease, Trey Yesavage, José Soriano and Spencer Miles. That’s a fine enough place to be in late October, and the Blue Jays will absolutely be adding to that group.
2. RF Addison Barger (Tommy John surgery)

This is a unique one for a position player. The Blue Jays expect Barger to be “close” to being ready for Spring Training, so it’s safer to look a little beyond that. If Barger can play the majority of the season, that’s a win. Bryce Harper once made a quick return from Tommy John surgery as a DH, but Barger isn’t a Harper-caliber hitter, so his throwing will need to be all the way back first.
3. OF/DH Anthony Santander (left shoulder surgery)

Santander was just about “back” by the end of 2026, but he ran out of time. The Blue Jays don’t want to clog up the DH spot with one hitter, so Santander will need to prove he can play the field, too. Given how the last two years have gone, the Blue Jays need to build a strong team and then consider Santander a bonus, if he can return to even 80 percent of his previous form.
4. RHP José Berríos (Tommy John surgery)
Berríos underwent surgery on May 20, so let’s use “late 2027” as a potential return. By April or May, we should have a much clearer picture.

The 32-year-old is the forgotten man, but this is still Berríos. The version of him we saw in 2025 clearly wasn’t near 100 percent, so what if Berríos still has a second act in him beyond this surgery? Once he opts in, he’ll be under contract for 2027 and '28, making $24 million per season, so he’ll get a shot. It’s still tough to bet against Berríos.
5. RHP Bowden Francis (Tommy John) and RHP Jake Bloss (Tommy John)

Bloss eventually ran into a teres major issue as he rehabbed, but these two right-handers were both lost for all of 2026. Francis should be ready later in ‘27, but Bloss will be ready to rock in Spring Training and has looked great in the Arizona Fall League.
Why will they matter? Imagine how many starts a healthy Francis or Bloss would have made in 2026. Could it have been 20? If injuries hit again, they’ll be crucial depth pieces.
items.titleZh: 伤员回归将塑造多伦多蓝鸟的休赛期计划
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟正盘点伤兵满营的2026赛季，多位核心球员的伤愈回归将直接影响球队的休赛期引援与规划。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 通讯。如需阅读完整通讯请点击此处，并订阅以定期在收件箱中接收。
多伦多报道 -- 在整个2026赛季的大部分时间里，感觉多伦多蓝鸟单凭伤病名单就能排出整套阵容，甚至包括一整套先发轮值。
有些伤病是可以预料的。当42岁的 Max Scherzer 几次进入伤病名单时，没人会感到意外。而当 José Berríos 在连续近十年没有缺席一场先发后接受 Tommy John 手术时，这极其不幸，但我们都理解棒球的现实和人类手肘的局限性。
多伦多蓝鸟现在正试图在运气不佳和可控变量之间寻找平衡。Cody Ponce 在处理滚地球时弄伤前十字韧带纯粹是运气太差，但当投手肩膀和手肘的问题开始堆积时，这就值得更深入地审视。
“我们绝不会对此耸耸肩不予理睬，”总经理 Ross Atkins 表示，“我们对目前的流程感觉良好，但我们确实需要做得更好，并使我们的招募群体多样化。”
多伦多蓝鸟在引进处于30岁初期至中期的资深投手方面通常做得不错。他们也有自己的“类型”。他们总是被投球动作“富有运动能力”的投手吸引，这意味着投手以流畅、自然的动作运用全身。想象一下 Dylan Cease 轻松滑下投手丘的样子，他的下半身承担了所有的重任。
伤病堆积得如此之快，以至于很难追踪它们，但在我们审视这支俱乐部的休赛期时，我们需要将所有这些潜在的回归因素考虑在内。多伦多蓝鸟将迎来一波健康的资深球员回归，这将塑造他们今年冬天的运作方式：
1. 右投手 Cody Ponce（右膝前十字韧带扭曲）
Ponce 在多伦多蓝鸟的首秀中仅投了 2 1/3 局，就在一垒附近处理一次尴尬的滚地球时弄伤了膝盖。不过他将完全康复，因此问题仅在于他在2026赛季全部报销后，能在2027赛季投多少局。

记住，在2026赛季，这支球队只有两名投手的投球局数超过 100 局——Cease 和 Kevin Gausman。多伦多蓝鸟不需要 Ponce 先发 32 场，但投出 120 局以上将是受欢迎的。如果明天就开赛，他将与 Cease、Trey Yesavage、José Soriano 和 Spencer Miles 一起进入先发轮值。在10月下旬，这是一个相当不错的位置，多伦多蓝鸟绝对会继续为这个群体补充战力。
2. 右外野手 Addison Barger（Tommy John 手术）
对于野手来说，这是一个独特的情况。多伦多蓝鸟预计 Barger 将“接近”为春训做好准备，因此将目光稍微放远一点会更稳妥。如果 Barger 能打满大部分赛季，那就是一场胜利。Bryce Harper 曾作为指定打击从 Tommy John 手术中迅速复出，但 Barger 不是 Harper 级别的高水平打者，因此他的传球能力需要先完全恢复。
3. 外野手/指定打击 Anthony Santander（左肩手术）
Santander 在2026年底时几乎已经“满血回归”，但时间不够了。多伦多蓝鸟不想用一名打者堵死指定打击的位置，因此 Santander 也需要证明自己能够防守。鉴于过去两年的经历，多伦多蓝鸟需要打造一支强大的球队，然后将 Santander 的回归视为一种额外奖励，前提是他能恢复到以前状态的 80%。
4. 右投手 José Berríos（Tommy John 手术）
Berríos 于5月20日接受了手术，因此我们以“2027年后期”作为潜在的回归时间。到4月或5月，我们应该会有更清晰的画面。
这位32岁的球员成了被遗忘的人，但他依然是 Berríos。我们在2025年看到的那个版本显然远未达到百分之百，那么如果 Berríos 在这次手术之后还有第二春呢？一旦他执行球员选项，他在2027和2028赛季都将处于合同期内，每个赛季赚取 2400 万美元，所以他会得到机会。唱衰 Berríos 依然很难。
5. 右投手 Bowden Francis（Tommy John）与右投手 Jake Bloss（Tommy John）
Bloss 在复健过程中最终遇到了背阔肌问题，但这两位右投手在2026赛季全部报销。Francis 应该会在2027年稍晚准备就绪，而 Bloss 将在春训中蓄势待发，并且在亚利桑那秋季联赛中表现出色。
为什么他们很重要？想象一下，一个健康的 Francis 或 Bloss 在2026赛季能先发多少场。会是 20 场吗？如果伤病再次来袭，他们将是至关重要的深度拼图。

items.titleEn: Each team's top performer from the 2026 Draft
bodyEn: You can only make one first impression.

Organizations handle recent Draft picks in all sorts of ways. Sometimes, they’ll hold them back for lighter work at the Spring Training complex, work that continues into fall instructs or bridge-league play. Sometimes, they’ll push them out to an affiliate to get their feet wet in pro ball and establish a foundation on which to build moving forward.

For the latter group, post-Draft performance can often be a mixed bag with some struggling out of the gate after long high-school or collegiate seasons and subsequent layoffs before the Draft. But if nothing else, all in-game looks are more information about players, and you’d rather get off to a good start than a bad one.
Here are the best professional debuts from the 2026 Draft from each of the 30 farm systems:
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Jake Bennett, 1B/OF (not ranked)The eighth-rounder was just a $1,000 signing as a senior out of Dallas Baptist, where he hit .346/.475/.776 with 19 homers over 43 games in the spring, and he very much carried his hard-hitting ways to Single-A Dunedin. Bennett had a .278/.388/.639 slash with seven long balls over 23 games in the pitcher-friendly Florida State League, and the data backed up the slugging-heavy numbers with a 114.4 mph max exit velocity and 111.3 mph 90th-percentile average EV in the small sample. He primarily played DH for Dunedin, but Bennett hit enough to draw more attention heading into next year.

Orioles: Ty Head, OF (No. 15)Head hit 14 homers, swiped 26 bags and played an outstanding center field as a Draft-eligible sophomore, allowing him to rise into the second round even though he hit only .291 for the year. He has 20-20 potential with an advanced approach at the plate, showing some of it off by hitting a combined .310/.395/.437 over 21 regular season games across both levels of A ball.

Rays: Grady Emerson, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 12)Only two players from the Rays’ 2026 class played after the Draft this year (18th-round pitcher Nate Smithburg being the other). So the fact that the second overall pick, who was still playing high-school ball in Texas only months earlier, saw time at Single-A Charleston (including a run to the Carolina League Finals) is notable. Emerson only went 9-for-55 (.164) with a triple in his 14 total games with the RiverDogs, but this was all about giving him a look at full-season ball to prepare him for his first full season at age 19 in 2027.

Red Sox: Owen Hull, OF (No. 8)After finishing second in NCAA Division I in hits (103) and RBI (87) and third in doubles (27) while leading North Carolina to a runner-up finish at the College World Series, Hull turned pro as a supplemental second-rounder and continued to rake. Featuring growing power and plus speed, he slashed .337/.436/.531 with three homers in 24 High-A games.

Yankees: Anthony Potestio, 3B/SS (not ranked)Known much more for his on-base skills than his power at UC San Diego, Potestio matched his college career high with five homers in 19 Single-A games. The 11th-rounder batted .333/.413/.684 and drew 19 walks in 80 plate appearances.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Alejandro Garza, 2B (not ranked)Garza's bat-to-ball skills stand out more than any of his physical tools, and he struck out just 5 percent of the time in three college seasons at Cal Poly. A 15th-rounder, he hit .347/.405/.472 with a 14 percent K rate in 18 Single-A contests.

Royals: Zion Rose, OF (No. 6)A surprise pick to many at No. 6 overall, Rose was assigned to High-A Quad Cities out of the gate and was a part of the River Bandits’ Midwest League championship squad, hitting .241/.367/.299 with one homer and an 18/17 K/BB ratio over 23 total games between the regular season and playoffs. His 2026 isn’t done yet, however, and that’s why he’s the pick here. The Royals sent the former Louisville outfielder to the Arizona Fall League to make up for some of the at-bats he missed due to ankle and hamstring injuries in the spring, and entering Wednesday, he’s gone 7-for-23 (.304) with a homer, a triple, six walks through his first six games for Surprise.

Tigers: Cameron Flukey, RHP (No. 5)Flukey was out for two months for Coastal Carolina in the spring due to a rib stress fracture, but that didn’t scare the Tigers away from taking him 22nd overall in July. The missed time did allow the 6-foot-6 righty to get a rare early taste of the Minors for a college arm, and he responded to the opportunity by throwing 10 ⅓ scoreless innings for Single-A Lakeland, striking out 14 and walking seven in the process. He relied heavily on a 93-95 mph four-seamer that averaged 19 inches of ride and also mixed in a cutter, slider, curveball and changeup for a full arsenal.

Twins: Vahn Lackey, C (No. 2/MLB No. 18)Lackey joined a long list of Georgia Tech catchers to go in the first round (Jason Varitek, Matt Wieters, Joey Bart, Kevin Parada) when the Twins took him No. 3 overall after he slashed .397/.519/.772 as a junior with the Yellow Jackets. He has the potential to be a plus hitter with plus power at the highest level and after getting his feet wet with a .759 OPS in 15 games with Single-A Ft. Myers, he hit .316/.500/.500 over 10 games with High-A Cedar Rapids.

White Sox: Clay Burdette, OF (not ranked)Burdette offered one of the best combinations of physicality (6-foot-2, 215 pounds) and athleticism in the 2026 class, which landed him in the seventh round and allowed him to surpass 2017 eighth-rounder Rylan Bannon as the highest-drafted position player in Xavier history. He displayed well above-average raw power and plus speed while slashing .274/.381/.481 with two homers and 13 steals in 29 Single-A contests.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Gavin Grahovac, 3B (No. 10)After missing most of his sophomore year at Texas A&M because of a torn left labrum, Grahovac returned to hit 22 homers and greatly cut down his strikeout rate in 2026, helping him land in the third round. He kept on mashing during a 24-game debut in the Single-A California League, with 14 extra-base hits (eight homers) in 92 at-bats for a 1.043 OPS.

Astros: Logan Hughes, OF (No. 3)Hughes' track record of performance at Stetson and Texas Tech and his penchant for hard contact made him one of the more desirable college bats in the 2026 crop, though a bit of a surprise first-round pick at No. 17 overall. He lived up to his reputation in his debut, hitting .333/.443/.605 with four homers and eight steals in 21 Single-A games.

A’s: Drew Burress, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 37)Burress might be undersized at his listed 5-foot-9, but he has plenty of thump at the plate. He went No. 8 overall in the Draft as the highest-ranked college outfielder in the class following a junior season that saw him post a 1.130 OPS for Georgia Tech. He homered in his first pro at-bat with Single-A Stockton, and hit seven total in 28 games to finish with a .291/.431/.591 line.

Mariners: Ace Reese, 3B (No. 8)Reese started at Houston then spent two years raking at Mississippi State, with 45 homers over his sophomore and junior seasons. After landing in the first round (No. 24 overall) with the Mariners, he made a very strong first impression with 100 plate appearances for Single-A Inland Empire, finishing with a .440/.530/.667 OPS (eight doubles, three homers).

Rangers: Kaden Carpenter, OF/1B (not ranked)The highest-drafted player in Utah Valley history, Carpenter became a ninth-round senior sign after slamming 17 homers during the spring. Known for producing high exit velocities, he batted .229/.393/.476 with six homers in 31 Single-A games.
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Carter Beck, OF (No. 14)The Braves got a PPI pick thanks to Drake Baldwin’s Rookie of the Year win, and they used it to take Beck, the Missouri Valley Conference Player of the Year at Indiana State after he hit .346/.446/.637 as a junior. After signing, he hit .409 over 11 games with Single-A Augusta and though he cooled off with a move to High-A Rome, he finished with a .283 average and .400 OBP, walking nearly as much as he struck out over 29 total games.

Marlins: Jacob Lombard, SS (No. 4/MLB No. 65)The son of former big leaguer George Lombard and brother of Yankees rookie shortstop George Lombard Jr., Jacob featured some of the best all-around tools among 2026 prepsters and went 14th overall out of a Miami high school. The Marlins immediately challenged him by sending him to Single-A, and he responded by hitting .220/.343/.390 -- good for a 98 wRC+ at age 18 -- with four homers and 11 steals in 22 games.

Mets: Ryan Tayman, C (not ranked)After two years at Cal, Tayman transferred to Cal Poly for his junior year and exploded with a career-best 18 homers, more than triple his sophomore total of five. He won co-Big West Player of the Year honors for that effort and also was named Most Outstanding Player in the Los Angeles regional for his postseason work. After going to the Mets in the ninth round, he carried those hard-hitting ways to Single-A St. Lucie, where he hit .316/.432/.579 with five homers in 21 games. His work on defense and against offspeed stuff will deserve monitoring, but this is a strong start.

Nationals: Zack Konstantinovsky, RHP (not ranked)After missing the 2025 season due to injury, Konstantinovsky returned to the Rutgers rotation this spring and showed enough stuff to go to the Nats in the 14th round as a redshirt sophomore. He made four appearances (one start) for Single-A Fredericksburg after signing for $150,000, and didn’t allow a run or walk while fanning eight over six scoreless innings. It was a small sample, sure, but the quality 80-83 mph changeup that was his best pitch with the Scarlet Knights carried over to pro ball, eliciting eight whiffs on 16 swings against it in the Carolina League.

Phillies: Reece Moroney, 2B/SS (not ranked)A three-year starter at shortstop for Rhode Island who hit .370/.426/.494 as a junior, Moroney went in the 10th round of the Draft to the Phillies. He’s a steady defender who mostly played second base during his pro debut while continuing to show off his excellent bat-to-ball skills by hitting .429/.515/.518 over a brief 14-game stint with Single-A Clearwater after signing.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Sawyer Strosnider, OF (No. 16)The 2026 second-rounder provided one of the highlights of the Minor League Baseball season when he hit his first pro homer to his father on Aug. 19. But the TCU product was more than that, hitting .276/.388/.448 with nine extra-base hits and seven steals in his 22 games with High-A Wisconsin after the Draft. Strosnider is a power-speed threat in a deep Brewers system but will need to improve his contact and groundball rates to maintain this level of production at higher levels.

Cardinals: Owen Henne, INF (not ranked)St. Louis was widely seen as having the deepest class in this year’s Draft, and if the organization’s sixth-rounder out of Division II Seton Hill continues to produce like this, it could look even deeper in quick order. Henne went 12-for-55 (.218) in 16 games for Single-A Palm Beach, but of those 12 hits, eight went for extra bases with four homers and four doubles. He added nine walks and only 11 strikeouts in that time too. Henne rotated between second, third and shortstop on the defensive side as he worked his way into St. Louis’ infield depth chart.

Cubs: Caden Sorrell, OF (No. 7)Sorrell has two grandfathers who played in the Majors -- Tom Griffin and Billy Sorrell -- and the tools to reach that level. His plus raw power, speed and arm strength prompted the Cubs to select him in the second round, after which he slashed .295/.347/.523 with five homers and eight steals in 22 Single-A contests.

Pirates: Chris Rembert, 2B (No. 9)Rembert parlayed his plus hit tool and excellent knowledge of the strike zone as a Draft-eligible sophomore into being taken by the Pirates in the supplemental second round. After hitting .343 at Auburn, he got his feet wet with Single-A Bradenton, hitting .284 with a .415 OBP and nine steals in 18 games

Reds: Justin Lebron, SS (No. 3)Perhaps the toolsiest, and most enigmatic, hitter in the Draft class, Lebron’s uneven junior season at Alabama, where he hit just .229 in SEC play, led to him lasting to the Reds’ pick at No. 18 overall. The Reds sent him out to High-A Dayton for his debut and all of his tools were on display over 23 games as he posted a .940 OPS with eight homers and six steals before helping the Dragons reach the Midwest League Championship Series.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: Ryder Helfrick, C (No. 2)Arizona’s strength on the farm is its catching, and the D-backs bolstered that by taking the Arkansas backstop 15th overall in July. Helfrick came as advertised offensively, showing off good power with five homers and a .521 slugging percentage in 24 games with Single-A Visalia while struggling against breaking balls and offspeed leading to a 26.4 percent K rate. His defense and arm strength behind the plate, along with the pop, can help paper over some of the hit-tool concerns.

Dodgers: Caleb Johnson, SS (unranked)A four-year starter at Jacksonville State, Johnson is a switch-hitter with good actions at shortstop, gap power and baserunning savvy. The 13th-rounder batted .293/.375/.537 with five homers and nine steals in 22 Single-A games.

Giants: Tanner Mally, OF (unranked)Mally went in the 17th round after winning the NCAA Division I batting title with a .446 average and setting Western Michigan records with 87 hits and a .554 on-base percentage. A career .400 hitter in college, he has elite bat-to-ball skills and well-above-average speed that translated into a .383/.523/.494 pro debut with eight steals in 24 Single-A games.

Padres: Joe Tiroly, INF (unranked)After transferring from Rider to Virginia as a junior, Tiroly’s lone year with the Cavaliers began with a foot injury in the fall, so it was promising to see the seventh-round pick's 2026 end on a powerful note. Playing for the California League champion Single-A Lake Elsinore, the infielder went 27-for-84 (.321) with seven homers and five doubles in 22 games between the regular season and playoffs and picked up five hits and three steals over the three-game Championship Series against San Jose.

Rockies: Daniel Jackson, C (No. 6)Jackson won the Golden Spikes Award after becoming the first Division I catcher to post a 25-25 season while winning the SEC triple crown (.379, 32 homers, 87 RBI). After the Rockies took him in the Competitive Balance Round A, the right-handed hitting backstop slashed .309/.408/.593, with five doubles and six homers in 22 games for Single-A Fresno.
items.titleZh: 2026年选秀各队最佳表现球员
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点并介绍了30支球队在2026年选秀中表现最出色的新秀球员。
bodyZh: 你只有一次机会留下第一印象。
各支球团以各种方式处理最近选秀选进的新秀。有时，他们会把新秀留在春训基地进行轻松的训练，这种训练会持续到秋季教学联盟或过渡联盟比赛。有时，他们会把球员派往小联盟分部，让他们在职业棒球中初露锋芒，为未来的发展打下基础。
对于后一组球员来说，选秀后的表现往往参差不齐，有些人在经历了漫长的高中或大学赛季以及选秀前的休整期后，开局时会陷入挣扎。但不管怎样，所有实战表现都能提供更多关于球员的信息，比起开局不利，你当然更希望有一个好的开始。
以下是来自30个农场系统中2026年选秀的最佳职业首秀：

美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：Jake Bennett，一垒手/外野手（未排入榜单）这位第八轮新秀是达拉斯浸会大学的大四学生，当时仅以1,000美元签约，他在春季的43场比赛中打出.346/.475/.776的打击三围，并有19支本垒打，他将强力打击的风格完美带到了单A达尼丁。Bennett在对投手有利的佛罗里达州立联盟的23场比赛中交出.278/.388/.639的打击三围和7支长打，这些重炮数据也有数据支撑，在小样本中最高击球初速达到114.4英里/小时，90百分位平均击球初速为111.3英里/小时。他在达尼丁主要担任指定打击，但Bennett的打击表现足以在进入明年时吸引更多关注。
巴尔的摩金莺：Ty Head，外野手（第15名）Head作为符合选秀资格的大二学生，轰出14支本垒打、盗垒26次并镇守极佳的中外野，这让他在全年打击率仅有.291的情况下依然杀入第二轮。他具备20-20的潜力和成熟的打击策略，在A级两个级别的21场常规赛中展现出来，总计交出.310/.395/.437的打击三围。

坦帕湾光芒：Grady Emerson，游击手（第1名/大联盟第1名/大联盟第12名）光芒2026届选秀中只有两名球员在选秀后参加了今年的比赛（另一位是第18轮投手Nate Smithburg）。因此，这位几个月前还在得克萨斯州打高中棒球的第二顺位新秀，能够在单A查尔斯顿获得出场机会（包括一路打进卡罗莱纳联盟决赛）是值得注意的。Emerson在效力RiverDogs的总共14场比赛中55打数仅9安打（.164）并带有1支三振，但这纯粹是为了让他体验全季赛事的比赛，为他在2027年19岁时迎来第一个完整赛季做准备。
波士顿红袜：Owen Hull，外野手（第8名）在NCAA第一级别联赛中安打数（103）和打点（87）排名第二、二垒安打（27）排名第三，并带领北卡罗来纳大学夺得大学世界大赛亚军后，Hull作为第二轮补充轮新秀投身职业棒球并持续火热输出。凭借不断增长的力量和出色的速度，他在高阶单A的24场比赛中交出.337/.436/.531的打击三围和3支本垒打。
纽约洋基：Anthony Potestio，三垒手/游击手（未排入榜单）在加州大学圣迭戈分校时，Potestio以其上垒能力而非长打能力闻名，他在19场单A比赛中追平了大学生涯单季最高的5支本垒打。这位第11轮新秀在80个打席中打出.333/.413/.684的打击三围并获得19次保送。
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：Alejandro Garza，二垒手（未排入榜单）Garza的球棒接触球能力比他任何一项身体天赋都更加突出，在加州理工波莫纳分校的三个大学赛季中，他的三振率仅为5%。作为一名第15轮新秀，他在18场单A比赛中交出.347/.405/.472的打击三围，三振率为14%。

堪萨斯城皇家：Zion Rose，外野手（第6名）作为总体顺位第6的意外之选，Rose一出道就被分配到高阶单A双城四城队，并且是River Bandits中西部联盟冠军阵容的一员，在常规赛和季后赛共计23场比赛中，他交出.241/.367/.299的打击三围，有1支本垒打以及18/17的三振/保送比。不过，他的2026赛季还没有结束，这也是他入选的原因。皇家队将这位前路易斯安那州立大学的外野手送往亚利桑那秋季联盟，以弥补他在春季因脚踝和大腿拉伤而错失的一些打席。截至周三，他在萨普赖斯的前6场比赛中23打数7安打（.304），包含1支本垒打、1支三振和6次保送。

底特律老虎：Cameron Flukey，右投手（第5名）Flukey在春季因肋骨疲劳性骨折为海岸卡罗来纳大学缺阵两个月，但这并没有吓退老虎队在7月以第22顺位选中他。这段缺阵时间确实让这位身高6英尺6英寸的右投手获得了一名大学投手罕见的小联盟早期体验，他用行动回报了这份机遇，在单A莱克兰投了10.1局无失分，送出14次三振和7次保送。他极度依赖一颗球速93-95英里/小时、平均有19英寸垂直位移的四缝线速球，同时还混用卡特球、滑球、曲球和变速球，构成了完整的球路武器库。

明尼苏达双城：Vahn Lackey，捕手（第2名/大联盟第18名）当双城在第3顺位选中Lackey时，他加入佐治亚理工学院首轮捕手的长长名单（Jason Varitek, Matt Wieters, Joey Bart, Kevin Parada），此前他在黄蜂队的三个大三赛季交出.397/.519/.772的打击三围。他有潜力在最高水平的赛场成为一名兼具优质打击与力量的打者，在单A麦尔兹堡通过15场比赛交出.759的OPS适应环境后，他在高阶单A锡达拉皮兹的10场比赛中打出.316/.500/.500的打击三围。

芝加哥白袜：Clay Burdette，外野手（未排入榜单）Burdette展现了2026届新秀中身体条件（6英尺2英寸，215磅）与运动能力的最佳结合之一，这让他进入了第七轮，并超越2017年第八轮新秀Rylan Bannon，成为泽维尔大学历史上顺位最高的位置球员。他在29场单A比赛中展现了远超平均水平的纯粹力量和出色的速度，交出.274/.381/.481的打击三围，并有2支本垒打和13次盗垒。
美国联盟西区
洛杉矶天使：Gavin Grahovac，三垒手（第10名）在因左肩唇撕裂错过得克萨斯农工大学大部分大二赛季后，Grahovac在2026年回归并轰出22支本垒打，大幅降低了三振率，这帮助他在第三轮被选中。在单A加州联盟的24场首秀中，他延续了火热状态，在92个打数中敲出14支长打（8支本垒打），OPS高达1.043。
休斯敦太空人：Logan Hughes，外野手（第3名）Hughes在斯泰森大学和得克萨斯理工大学的过往表现记录以及对扎实击球的偏好，使他成为2026届新秀中最受欢迎的大学打者之一，尽管在第17顺位被选为首轮秀多少有些令人意外。他在首秀中不负众望，在21场单A比赛中交出.333/.443/.605的打击三围，并有4支本垒打和8次盗垒。
运动家：Drew Burress，外野手（第2名/大联盟第37名）Burress身高登记虽然只有5英尺9英寸显得有些矮小，但他在打击区上极具爆发力。在度过佐治亚理工学院交出1.130 OPS的大三赛季后，他作为该届排名最高的大学外野手在选秀中以第8顺位被选中。他在单A斯托克顿的职业生涯首个打席就轰出本垒打，在28场比赛中共计打出7支本垒打，最终交出.291/.431/.591的成绩单。
西雅图水手：Ace Reese，三垒手（第8名）Reese先是在休斯敦效力，随后在密西西比州立大学度过了两个火力全开的赛季，在大二和大三赛季共敲出45支本垒打。在水手队首轮（总体第24顺位）选中他之后，他在单A库加兰帝国获得的100个打席中留下了极佳的第一印象，最终的OPS为.440/.530/.667（包含8支二垒安打、3支本垒打）。
得克萨斯游骑兵：Kaden Carpenter，外野手/一垒手（未排入榜单）作为犹他谷大学历史上顺位最高的球员，Carpenter在春季轰出17支本垒打后，成为一名在第九轮被签下的大四球员。他以制造高击球初速而闻名，在31场单A比赛中交出.229/.393/.476的打击三围和6支本垒打。
国家联盟东区

亚特兰大勇士：Carter Beck，外野手（第14名）勇士队由于Drake Baldwin赢得年度最佳新秀而获得了PPI选秀权，他们用这个选秀权选中了Beck。Beck在印第安纳州立大学大三赛季交出.346/.446/.637的打击三围，荣膺密苏里山谷联盟年度最佳球员。签约后，他在单A奥古斯塔的11场比赛中打出.409的打击率；尽管升至高阶单A罗马后手感冷却，但他在总共29场比赛中仍交出.283的打击率和.400的上垒率，保送次数几乎与三振次数相当。

迈阿密马林鱼：Jacob Lombard，游击手（第4名/大联盟第65名）前大联盟球员George Lombard之子、洋基队新秀游击手George Lombard Jr.的兄弟，Jacob拥有2026届高中生中最顶尖的全面身手之一，在迈阿密的一所高中被以第14顺位选中。马林鱼队直接将他派往单A以示挑战，他用表现作出了回应——在18岁时交出.220/.343/.390的打击三围（相当于98的wRC+），在22场比赛中打出4支本垒打并有11次盗垒。

纽约大都会：Ryan Tayman，捕手（未排入榜单）在加州大学效力两年后，Tayman转学至加州理工波莫纳分校度过大三赛季，并迎来了爆发，创下生涯新高的18支本垒打，是其大二赛季5支本垒打的三倍还多。他凭借这一表现荣获大威斯特联盟年度最佳球员共同得主，并因其在季后赛中的表现被评为洛杉矶区域赛的最杰出球员。在第9轮被大都会队选中后，他将这种强力打击的风格带到了单A圣露西，在21场比赛中打出.316/.432/.579的打击三围和5支本垒打。他在防守端以及应对球速较慢的变化球方面的表现值得持续关注，但这是一个强有力的开局。

华盛顿国民：Zack Konstantinovsky，右投手（未排入榜单）因伤缺席2025赛季后，Konstantinovsky在今年春季重返罗格斯大学的先发轮值，并展现出足够的实力，以红衫大二生身份在第14轮被国民队选中。在以15万美元签约后，他为单A弗雷德里克斯堡出战4场（1场先发），在投出的6局无失分中没有送出任何失分或保送，同时三振8人。样本虽小，但他效力红衣主教期间作为杀手锏的优质80-83英里/小时变速球在职业赛场得以延续，在卡罗莱纳联盟面对这颗球的16次挥击中制造了8次挥空。
费城费城人：Reece Moroney，二垒手/游击手（未排入榜单）作为罗德岛大学三年的主力游击手，Moroney在大三时打出.370/.426/.494的打击成绩，在选秀中于第10轮被费城人队选中。他是一名稳健的防守球员，在职业首秀期间主要镇守二垒，同时继续展现出他出色的球棒接触球能力，在签约后效力单A克利尔沃特的短暂14场比赛中交出.429/.515/.518的打击三围。

国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：Sawyer Strosnider，外野手（第16名）这位2026年的第二轮新秀在8月19日将职业生涯首支本垒打轰向他的父亲时，奉献了小联盟棒球赛季的高光时刻之一。但这位得克萨斯基督教大学的出品不仅于此，选秀结束后他在高阶单A威斯康星的22场比赛中，交出.276/.388/.448的打击三围，并有9支长打和7次盗垒。Strosnider是酿酒人深厚农场体系中的一个力量与速度兼具的威胁，但若想在更高阶的赛场维持这种水平的产出，他需要提升球棒击球率和滚地球率。

圣路易斯红雀：Owen Henne，内野手（未排入榜单）外界普遍认为圣路易斯拥有今年选秀中最深厚的阵容，如果该组织的第二级别西东山大学第六轮新秀继续保持这种产出，他们的阵容深度可能会以更快的速度显得更加深厚。Henne在单A棕榈滩的16场比赛中55打数12安打（.218），但这12支安打中有8支是长打，包括4支本垒打和4支二垒安打。在此期间他还获得了9次保送，仅有11次三振。Henne在防守端轮流镇守二垒、三垒和游击，逐渐确立了自己在圣路易斯内野深度图中的位置。
芝加哥小熊：Caden Sorrell，外野手（第7名）Sorrell有两位曾在Mlb效力的祖父——Tom Griffin和Billy Sorrell——并且具备达到那个水平的实力。他出色的纯力量、速度和臂力促使小熊队在第二轮选中了他，随后他在22场单A比赛中交出.295/.347/.523的打击三围，并有5支本垒打和8次盗垒。
匹兹堡海盗：Chris Rembert，二垒手（第9名）Rembert凭借身为符合选秀资格的大二学生所具备的出色球棒接触能力和对好球带的精妙理解，在补充第二轮被海盗队选中。在奥本大学打出.343的打击率后，他在单A布雷登顿初露锋芒，在18场比赛中打出.284的打击率、.415的上垒率以及9次盗垒。
辛辛那提红人：Justin Lebron，游击手（第3名）Lebron或许是选秀届中天赋最高也最令人捉摸不透的打者。他在阿拉巴马大学的大三赛季表现起伏不定，在东南联盟的比赛中打击率仅为.229，这导致他掉到了红人队在第18顺位的选择。红人队将他派往高阶单A代顿进行首秀，他在23场比赛中全面展现了自己的天赋，交出.940的OPS，并有8支本垒打和6次盗垒，随后帮助飞龙队杀入中西部联盟冠军赛。
国家联盟西区

亚利桑那响尾蛇：Ryder Helfrick，捕手（第2名）亚利桑那农场体系的优势在于其捕手深度，响尾蛇队在7月以第15顺位选中这位阿肯色大学的主力捕手进一步巩固了这一点。Helfrick在进攻端表现符合预期，在单A维萨利亚的24场比赛中展现出出色的长打能力，有5支本垒打和.521的长打率，不过由于对决变化球和球速较慢的球时遇到困难，导致他的三振率达到了26.4%。他在本垒板后的防守和臂力，加上爆发力，足以掩盖一些关于其打击能力的担忧。
洛杉矶道奇：Caleb Johnson，游击手（未排入榜单）作为杰克逊维尔州立大学四年的主力球员，Johnson是一名左右开弓的打者，在游击防区动作敏捷，具备拉出防区空当的力量以及出色的垒球意识。这位第13轮新秀在22场单A比赛中打出.293/.375/.537的打击三围，并有5支本垒打和9次盗垒。
旧金山巨人：Tanner Mally，外野手（未排入榜单）Mally在以.446的打击率赢得NCAA第一级别联赛打击王并创下西密歇根大学87支安打和.554上垒率的纪录后，在第17轮被选中。作为一名大学生涯打击率达到.400的打者，他拥有极精英级别的球棒接触能力和远超平均水平的速度，这些转化为他在单A的职业首秀中交出.383/.523/.494的打击三围以及8次盗垒。

圣迭戈教士：Joe Tiroly，内野手（未排入榜单）在从里德大学转学到弗吉尼亚大学读大三后，Tiroly在骑士队的唯一一个赛季是以秋季的一次脚踝受伤开局的，因此看到这位第七轮新秀的2026赛季以强势收尾令人备受鼓舞。效力于加州联盟冠军单A雷克瑟尔时，这位内野手在常规赛和季后赛共计22场比赛中84打数27安打（.321），包含7支本垒打和5支二垒安打，并在对阵圣何塞的三场冠军系列赛中拿下5支安打和3次盗垒。
科罗拉多洛矶：Daniel Jackson，捕手（第6名）Jackson在成为第一位打出25-25赛季并夺得东南联盟三冠王（打击率.379、32支本垒打、87分打点）的第一级别联赛捕手后，荣获金钉鞋奖。在洛矶队在竞争平衡轮A选中这位右打捕身后，他在单A弗雷斯诺的22场比赛中交出.309/.408/.593的打击三围，并有5支二垒安打和6支本垒打。

items.titleEn: Is a reunion in store for Bieber and Blue Jays this offseason?
bodyEn: TORONTO -- This offseason doesn’t have a “reunion” drama that compares to Bo Bichette’s from last winter, but Shane Bieber still feels like the most interesting name of the bunch.

George Springer is 37 now, and while he’s been vital to this organization for the past six seasons, the Blue Jays prefer more flexibility in their DH spot after Springer made 113 of his 115 starts there in 2026. Max Scherzer had his moments in Toronto, but is 42 now and coming off a 5.74 ERA with a handful of IL stints last year.

Bieber, still just 31, is obviously the most attractive name among the Blue Jays’ pending free agents. For a brief, healthy moment in 2026, it felt like Bieber could pitch his way into the qualifying offer conversation, but now he profiles as a rebound candidate, fresh off a 4.37 ERA over 11 starts in another injury-shortened season.

There still has to be some level of appeal from Bieber’s side, because what’s truly changed in the past year? When Bieber picked up his $16 million player option last offseason -- which surprised many at the time -- he spoke about Toronto as the best place to set himself up for free agency, praising the organization’s resources, pitching coaches and off-field factors, like the treatment of his family. Those haven’t gone anywhere.
What type of pitcher could Bieber be in 2027?

This is the tricky part. At this exact time last year, Bieber was coming off a strong finish to the regular season in Toronto after completing his Tommy John rehab. It was fully conceivable that, with a strong 2026 season, he’d launch himself towards the top of the free-agent pitching market in the ’26-27 offseason, right into the tier below Tarik Skubal. That hasn’t happened.
Ranking the top 10 free agents this offseason
Some lingering forearm and elbow issues cost Bieber the first half of 2026, then right teres major inflammation ended his season early after just 11 starts.

Who is Bieber, then? In the limited action we saw in 2026, his fastball averaged 92.3 mph, which is close enough to his career norms. There were some red flags, though, with a career-low strikeout rate (18.2%) and a career-low whiff rate (23.5%). That’s a very dangerous line for Bieber to walk, given that he’s more of a “control” pitcher and doesn’t overwhelm hitters with pure stuff.
Do the Blue Jays believe this is a dip that will rebound towards his career norms with a clean bill of health, or is that risk too great for them? As always … it depends on the price.
What could a Bieber contract look like?

It’s complicated. Re-establishing value and hitting the market again at 32 sounds most logical for Bieber, who could still set himself up well for a lucrative, multi-year deal. That’s the starting point.

Depending on the overall value, club and player options come into play here, and incentives could be attractive to either side. The Blue Jays leaned heavily into incentives for innings pitched with Scherzer this past year, whose base salary of $3 million had $10 million in potential incentives for innings pitched. That’s the extreme end of the spectrum, but still, incentives feel probable in a Bieber deal.
How serious is the Blue Jays’ pitching need?

If the season started tomorrow, it’s looking like: Dylan Cease, Trey Yesavage, José Soriano, Cody Ponce and Spencer Miles. That’s a fine start, especially when you factor in a handful of top pitching prospects who could be legitimate options early in the year.
Which Blue Jays prospects showed out in '26, could make impact in '27?

It’s not nearly enough, though. Remember Spring Training 2026, when the Blue Jays had eight starters and we all wondered how they’d handle it? The Blue Jays need to add multiple starters this offseason again, and you can expect them to. One-year stopgaps have rarely been their style, but value is value if they believe in Bieber to rebound.

The Blue Jays could also have José Berríos coming back later in the season after Tommy John surgery, but that’s to be treated as a bonus, not counted on. Frankly, if the Blue Jays feel open to a one-year deal with Bieber, a reunion with Kevin Gausman would have to come into that same conversation. Gausman will be 36 next season and coming off a 4.51 ERA last season, so if he chooses to pitch in 2027, perhaps he lands in the same range as the one-year, $18.5 million deal Chris Bassitt signed with the Orioles a year ago.
Bieber remains an option, though, and if he truly believed in the Blue Jays to help establish his free-agent value a year ago, not much has changed.
items.titleZh: Bieber和多伦多蓝鸟会在这个休赛期再续前缘吗？
items.summaryZh: 分析自由球员Shane Bieber在休赛期重返多伦多蓝鸟的可能性、合同预估及球队先发投手需求。
bodyZh: 多伦多报道——这个休赛期并没有像去年冬天Bo Bichette那样充满戏剧性的“重聚”话题，但Shane Bieber依然是这批球员中最受关注的名字。
George Springer如今已经37岁了。尽管他在过去六个赛季对这支球队至关重要，但在2026年Springer的115场先发中有113场担任指定打击之后，多伦多蓝鸟更希望在指定打击位置上保持更多灵活性。Max Scherzer在多伦多有过高光时刻，但他现在已经42岁，去年交出5.74自责分率且多次进入伤病名单。
现年31岁的Bieber显然是多伦多蓝鸟即将成为自由球员的名单中最具吸引力的名字。在2026年短暂保持健康的时期里，Bieber似乎有机会进入资质报价的讨论范围，但现在他更像是一名反弹候选人，在又一个因伤缩短的赛季中，他在11场先发中交出了4.37的自责分率。
Bieber的阵营肯定仍然对多伦多保有一定的好感，因为过去一年真正改变了什么呢？当Bieber在去年休赛期执行他价值1600万美元的球员选项时——当时让许多人感到惊讶——他曾将多伦多称为帮助自己备战自由球员市场的最佳地点，并称赞了球队的资源、投球教练以及场外因素，比如对他的家庭的照顾。这些都并没有消失。
2027年的Bieber会是一名什么样的投手？
这就是棘手的部分。就在去年的这个时候，Bieber在多伦多完成了Tommy John手术康复后，以强劲的表现结束了常规赛。完全可以想象，如果2026赛季表现出色，他将在26-27年休赛期将自己推向自由球员投手市场的前列，直逼Tarik Skubal之下的级别。但这并没有发生。
盘点本休赛期十大自由球员
一些挥之不去的前臂和手肘问题让Bieber缺席了2026年前半段的比赛，随后右大圆肌发炎导致他在仅登场11场后就提前结束了赛季。
那么，Bieber到底是谁？在2026年有限的出场中，他的直球平均球速为92.3英里，这与他职业生涯的常态相当接近。不过，这也出现了一些警讯，他的三振率（18.2%）和挥空率（23.5%）均创下职业生涯新低。对于Bieber来说，这是一条非常危险的边缘，因为他更多是一名“控球”型投手，并不能仅凭纯球威压制打者。
多伦多蓝鸟是否相信这是一个低谷，只要身体完全健康就能恢复到职业生涯的常态，还是说这个风险对他们来说太大了？和往常一样……这取决于价格。
Bieber的合同会是什么样的？
这很复杂。重新证明价值并在32岁时再次试水自由球员市场对Bieber来说是最合乎逻辑的选择，他依然可以为自己争取到一份丰厚的多年生合同。这是一个起点。
根据整体价值，球队选项和球员选项将会发挥作用，激励条款对双方也可能具有吸引力。过去一年，多伦多蓝鸟在Scherzer的合同上大量使用了与投球局数挂钩的激励条款，其300万美元的基本薪资带有1000万美元的潜在投球局数激励。这是极端的情况，不过在Bieber的合同中出现激励条款依然很有可能。
多伦多蓝鸟对投手的需求有多迫切？
如果明天就开赛，先发轮值看起来将是：Dylan Cease、Trey Yesavage、José Soriano、Cody Ponce和Spencer Miles。这是一个不错的开局，特别是当你把几位有望在明年初成为大联盟实质选项的顶级潜力新秀考虑在内时。
哪些多伦多蓝鸟的潜力新秀在26年崭露头角，并可能在27年产生影响？
不过，这还远远不够。还记得2026年春训时，多伦多蓝鸟拥有八名先发投手，当时所有人都想知道他们将如何应对？这个休赛期多伦多蓝鸟需要再次补强多名先发投手，你可以预料到他们会这么做。一年期的权宜之计很少是他们的风格，但如果他们相信Bieber能够反弹，价值就是价值。

多伦多蓝鸟也可能在赛季后期迎来接受Tommy John手术后回归的José Berríos，但这应当被视为一种附加红利，而不是可以依赖的筹码。坦白说，如果多伦多蓝鸟对给Bieber一年期合同持开放态度，那么与Kevin Gausman的重聚也必须被纳入同样的讨论中。Gausman下赛季将年满36岁，上赛季自责分率4.51，所以如果他选择在2027年投球，或许他的身价会与Chris Bassitt一年前和巴尔的摩金莺签下的1年1850万美元合同处于同一区间。
不过，Bieber依然是一个备选项，如果他一年前真的相信多伦多蓝鸟能帮助他确立自由球员价值，那么情况并没有发生太大变化。

items.titleEn: Which Blue Jays prospects showed out in '26, could make impact in '27?
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson's Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- For another year, you need to take a few steps back to fully appreciate the Blue Jays’ farm system and its impact on this organization.

The Blue Jays’ Top 30 prospects list captures a year of growth and change, but it also captures what’s left. The Blue Jays graduated another group of their more mature prospects in 2026, including Sean Keys, who led the system with 28 home runs across two levels this season. Charles McAdoo also made the jump, another development success story whose tools finally started to flash in the big leagues. Then there was Brett Bateman, a Trade Deadline addition from the Cubs in the Kevin Gausman deal who immediately outplayed expectations. The Deadline also saw the Blue Jays deal Arjun Nimmala -- at the time ranked No. 2 in their system -- to the Angels for José Soriano, who projects to be a cornerstone piece in their rotation.
Looking back, this is what stood out in 2026:
3 players who forced their way onto the radar this year

RHP Nolan Perry (No. 2): Perry made “the jump” teams dream of with each pitching prospect, launching himself onto the Top 100 prospect list (No. 90) in all of Major League Baseball. This is one of the Blue Jays’ biggest development success stories, a 12th-rounder from the 2022 Draft who missed ‘25 after undergoing Tommy John surgery, but came back even better. His velocity jumped up to the mid-90s, helping him to strike out 117 batters over 82 2/3 innings of work with a 2.50 ERA. He’s gone from a potential back-end starter to something much more exciting now, and could be an option for the Blue Jays as early as 2027 if he handles Triple-A Buffalo well.

RHP Danny Thompson Jr. (No. 14): Another example of the Blue Jays’ player development group taking a significant step forward on the pitching front, Thompson was an eighth-rounder in 2025 but has already taken a jump, too. With an uptick in stuff, Thompson posted a 3.41 ERA between High-A Vancouver and Double-A New Hampshire this season, striking out 11.1 batters per nine innings. Consider him another upper-Minors arm who could kick the door down in 2027.

UTIL Jay Harry (No. 21): Arguably the best story of the season among the Blue Jays’ hitting prospects, Harry completely changed the trajectory of his career in 2026. Coming off a .199 average and .572 OPS the year prior, the Blue Jays challenged Harry to swing harder and commit to some adjustments, which he nailed. The result was an .838 OPS with 14 homers, all while playing second, short and all three outfield spots. It’s very easy to see the 24-year-old impacting the MLB roster in 2027.
2 possible breakout players to watch in 2027

LHP Cole Carlon (No. 4): Carlon didn’t pitch after the Blue Jays selected him 39th overall in the 2026 Draft, but he fits the exact blueprint of a pitcher who could move quickly. With overwhelming stuff from the left side, Carlon could follow the old Trey Yesavage plan, starting in Single-A Dunedin to get his feet under himself before quick moves to High-A and Double-A. He’ll immediately be a must-watch prospect.

OF Jake Cook (No. 20): Cook is an incredible athlete, the fastest runner in the organization with tools for days. The Blue Jays are getting him more reps in the Arizona Fall League, and if Cook can fully uncork his physical potential, the sky is the limit here. At the very least, his value on the bases and in the field should carry him. If he hits, look out.

Let’s sneak in an honorable mention for catcher Will Brick (No. 5), too, their fourth-round pick who signed well over slot at $2.5M. To say the Blue Jays are “high” on Brick would be a wild understatement, even if his development may take some time out of high school.
1 big question for next season
How much can the farm system support the MLB rotation?

This was a gap that got exposed in 2026. When injuries crushed the Blue Jays’ rotation, there weren’t any polished prospects waiting in Triple-A to come up as optionable depth. With another year, that gap should be filled.

Perry and Thompson could soon represent those options in Triple-A, and while Johnny King (No. 3) still needs some more development to keep him in the zone, he’s getting closer, too. Beyond that, the Blue Jays have Gage Stanifer -- who could land in the bullpen long term, Jake Bloss, Daniel Guerra, John Klein and others.
Quantity is always the best approach, and if just one of those pitchers can help the big league club, it’s a major win for the Blue Jays’ roster construction.
items.titleZh: 哪些多伦多蓝鸟潜力新秀在2026年崭露头角，并可能在2027年产生影响？
items.summaryZh: 盘点在2026年表现出色的多伦多蓝鸟潜力新秀，并展望他们对2027赛季的可能影响。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 新闻简报。如需阅读完整简报，请点击这里，并订阅以定期在收件箱中接收。
多伦多报道——又是一年，你需要退后几步，才能全面评估多伦多蓝鸟的农场系统及其对这支球队的影响。

多伦多蓝鸟的前30大潜力新秀榜单记录了一年的成长与变化，同时也展现了留下的阵容。多伦多蓝鸟在2026年迎来了另一批较为成熟的潜力新秀升上大联盟，其中包括 Sean Keys，他本赛季在两个层级以28记本垒打领跑整个农场系统。Charles McAdoo 也实现了飞跃，作为另一个球团青训成功的范例，他的各项工具终于开始在大联盟中闪光。此外还有 Brett Bateman，他是通过 Kevin Gausman 的交易在交易截止日从芝加哥小熊引进的，并立即超越了预期。交易截止日还看到多伦多蓝鸟将 Arjun Nimmala——当时在他们的农场系统排名第2——交易至洛杉矶天使，换来被视为先发轮换基石人选的 José Soriano。
回首过去，2026年最引人注目的是：
3位今年强势闯入视野的球员

右投手 Nolan Perry（第2名）：Perry 实现了每支球队对投手新秀梦寐以求的“飞跃”，一举杀入全美大联盟前100大潜力新秀榜（第90名）。这是多伦多蓝鸟最成功的青训典范之一，他是2022年选秀大会的第12轮新秀，因接受汤米·约翰手术而缺席了2025赛季，但回归后表现更加出色。他的球速飙升至90英里/小时中段，帮助他在82又2/3局的投球中三振了117名打者，自责分率为2.50。他已经从一名潜在的后段先发投手蜕变得令人兴奋得多，如果他在3A布法罗表现顺利，最早在2027年就能成为多伦多蓝鸟的备选方案之一。
右投手 Danny Thompson Jr.（第14名）：作为多伦多蓝鸟球员发展部门在投手培养方面取得重大进展的又一个例证，Thompson 是2025年的第八轮新秀，但也已经实现了飞跃。随着球威的提升，Thompson 本赛季在高阶1A温哥华和2A新罕布什尔之间交出了3.41的自责分率，每9局三振11.1名打者。可以认为他是又一位有望在2027年敲响大联盟大门的农场高级别投手。

多功能球员 Jay Harry（第21名）：可以说是多伦多蓝鸟打者新秀中本赛季最佳的故事，Harry 在2026年彻底改变了其职业生涯的轨迹。在前一年交出.199打击率和.572上垒率加长打率后，多伦多蓝鸟激励 Harry 更用力挥棒并致力于做出一系列调整，而他完美地完成了这些调整。最终他的上垒率加长打率达到了.838并轰出14记本垒打，同时胜任了二垒、游击以及三个外场位置。这位24岁的球员在2027年对大联盟阵容产生影响是显而易见的。
2027年值得关注的2位可能爆发的球员
左投手 Cole Carlon（第4名）：在多伦多蓝鸟于2026年选秀大会第39顺位选中 Carlon 后，他尚未登板投球，但他完全符合那种能够快速升上的投手蓝图。凭借左投压倒性的球威，Carlon 可以遵循以往 Trey Yesavage 的计划，先从1A达尼丁起步以站稳脚跟，随后快速升至高阶1A和2A。他将立即成为一名必须密切关注的潜力新秀。
外场手 Jake Cook（第20名）：Cook 是一位不可思议的运动员，他是整个组织中跑得最快的球员，浑身都是天赋。多伦多蓝鸟正让他在亚利桑那秋季联赛中获得更多出场机会，如果 Cook 能完全释放其身体潜力，他的上限将不可限量。至少他在垒包上和防守端的价值应该能支撑他站稳脚跟。如果他能打出安打，那就要小心了。
让我们也顺便提一下捕手 Will Brick（第5名），他是球队第四轮选秀球员，以远超标准值的250万美元签约金签约。要说多伦多蓝鸟对 Brick“寄予厚望”那绝对是极其保守的说法，尽管他的成长可能需要一些高中毕业后的时间。
关于下个赛季的1大疑问
农场系统能在多大程度上支援大联盟先发轮换？
这是在2026年暴露出的一个漏洞。当伤病摧毁多伦多蓝鸟的先发轮换时，3A没有培养成熟的潜力新秀可以作为有选项深度的球员被调上来。再过一年，这个缺口应该会被填补。
Perry 和 Thompson 很快就能代表3A的这些备选方案，而尽管 Johnny King（第3名）仍需要更多发展来将球控制在好球带内，他也同样越来越接近这一目标。除此之外，多伦多蓝鸟还拥有 Gage Stanifer——他长期来看可能会进入牛棚——以及 Jake Bloss、Daniel Guerra、John Klein 等人。
数量永远是最好的方法，如果这些投手中有哪怕一人能够帮助大联盟俱乐部，对多伦多蓝鸟的阵容构建来说都是巨大的胜利。
